name: Choreo Planer
description: Agent skills exposed by Choreo Planer, a free online tool for planning cheerleading and dance choreography. Every skill is backed by the public REST API (https://api.choreo-planer.de/openapi.json) and the MCP server (https://api.choreo-planer.de/mcp).

skills.name: choreo-service
skills.description: Create, read, update and delete choreographies, including their hits, lineups and positions, and export countsheets as PDF or video.

skills.name: team-service
skills.description: Manage teams and their season assignments for a cheerleading or dance club.

skills.name: club-service
skills.description: Manage cheerleading and dance clubs and their metadata.

skills.name: member-service
skills.description: Manage the members of a club and their team memberships.

skills.name: position-service
skills.description: Manage the positions of members within a lineup for each count of a choreography.

skills.name: lineup-service
skills.description: Manage lineups that group member positions for a choreography.

skills.name: season-service
skills.description: Manage seasons used to scope teams and choreographies over time.

skills.name: season-team-service
skills.description: Manage assignments between seasons and teams.
